title: Source-bound scheduled irrigation TCS8 water-content threshold with DCS2 depth

source.lineage: SWAP-011 targets neither irrigation.f90 nor its AFGEN implementation; the B0 distribution source is unchanged in corrected B1.11.
equations: tcritab is AFGEN(value_tc8, dvs_tc8), populated from the seven-knot input table.
At the selected opportunity, TCS8 triggers when theta(sensor) <= AFGEN(tcritab, 14, dvs).
DCS2 event depth remains 0.1 * AFGEN(fidtab, 14, dvs) cm.

scope: typed scheduled selector supports both existing TCS7 pressure-head and new TCS8 water-content comparisons
TCS8 and DCS2 partial AFGEN table sentinel, lower clamp, interpolation and upper clamp
100000 deterministic input comparisons at O0 and O2 with O0/O2 transcript identity
non_goals: generic management parser or event-calendar ingestion
SSDI application, solute coupling or hydraulic source booking
changes to admitted F-APP07 TCS1/DCS2 application
new persistent state owner, restart schema, runtime or production admission
pass_conditions: existing TCS7/DCS2 source oracle remains unchanged and passes
TCS8 threshold and DCS2 depth match the B1.11 AFGEN source over 100000 deterministic inputs
TCS8 equality triggers and either side of equality follows the source comparison
a triggered scheduled event preserves the selected DCS2 amount and rate/duration identity
